basic_details.job_title: Kalyani University Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The University of Kalyani has invited applications from Indian citizens for one full-time regular post of Director at its Directorate of Open and Distance Learning (DODL), on a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,44,200 per month, with no other allowances admissible. The tenure is one year from joining, and the notice requires at least 10 years' experience in teaching and research. Applications are offline: the form is downloaded from https://www.klyuniv.ac.in and must be submitted from 4 November 2026 to 27 November 2026 (up to 4.30 P.M.).

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 68 (Sixty-Eight) years as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. It says the state government norms on reservations, as amended from time to time, will be followed, if applicable. | Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

selection_process: The notice mentions an interview. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee a call for interview

and the University reserves the right to decide the number of candidates to be called. Candidates may have to send scanned copies of all submitted documents to the Registrar electronically before the interview
so they should retain a complete set
including publications if any. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.
how_to_apply: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the university website https://www.klyuniv.ac.in. It is available from 04/11/2026 to 27/11/2026 (up to 4.30 P.M).
Write your mobile number and e-mail ID clearly, in CAPITAL LETTERS, in the application form.

Submit the duly filled-in form either in person at the Central Receipt and Dispatch Section, Administrative Building of the university, on all working days between 12.00 PM and 4.30 P.M, or send it by speed post/courier.
Address it to: The Registrar, University of Kalyani, P.O and P.S. Kalyani, District – Nadia, Pin – 741235, West Bengal.
Write the post applied for on the top of the envelope containing the application form, in capital letters as the notice requires.

Send the original Demand Draft for the application fee along with the form. Rs. 1000/- is payable by SC/ST/Differently abled (Physically as well as Visually) candidates and Rs. 1500/- by candidates belonging to UR and OBC categories. The Demand Draft is in favour of UNIVERSITY OF KALYANI payable at 'KALYANI'.
Demand Draft in original for the application fee
One (1) set of photocopies of all marksheets, certificates and other testimonials
Six (6) photocopies of the application form only
No Objection Certificate (NOC) / forwarding from/by the existing employer, if applicable
Applications received after 27/11/2026 (up to 4.30 P.M.) are not entertained, including for postal delay.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications are liable to be cancelled. The University reserves the right to withdraw the notification at any time, partially or completely, if situations so warrant. In that case the application fees will be refunded to the respective candidates. The NOC or forwarding is needed only if applicable, that is, for candidates with an existing employer. Candidates must keep a complete set of scanned copies of all submitted documents, including the application form and publications if any.

content_sections.heading: About University of Kalyani
content_sections.text: University of Kalyani is a university located at Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal. The Directorate of Open and Distance Learning (DODL) is the unit of the university in which this Director post sits. The notice is issued over the signature of the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The essential qualification and experience, as printed: A Ph.D. Degree with a minimum 55% marks (or equivalent Grade in a point scale whenever grading system is followed) will be required at Masters' Degree in any discipline in the areas of Humanities, Social Sciences, Sciences, Education, Commerce, Law and Management. At least 10 years' experience in teaching, research including 5 years of professional experience at senior supervisory level in the areas of educational planning, management and development including institution building, systems development etc. Of this, at least 5 years should be in Professor's scale. All essential qualifications must have been obtained from a recognized University/Institute, meaning one affiliated to UGC or other statutory apex bodies, or recognized by the State or Central Government as a centre of higher learning. A degree from a foreign University must be recognized as equivalent to its Indian counterpart by the Association of Indian Universities. Qualifications and experience attained up to the last date of application are counted. Candidates with relevant experience in the Distance Education System will be preferred. The upper age limit is 68 (Sixty-Eight) years as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. It says the state government norms on reservations, as amended from time to time, will be followed, if applicable. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay is a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,44,200 per month. Other allowances are not admissible. The post is on a full-time regular basis for one post. The tenure is one (1) year from the date of joining, and the tenure may be extended subject to satisfactory performance. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for University of Kalyani Director
content_sections.text: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the university website https://www.klyuniv.ac.in . It is available from 04/11/2026 to 27/11/2026 (up to 4.30 P.M). Write your mobile number and e-mail ID clearly, in CAPITAL LETTERS, in the application form. Submit the duly filled-in form either in person at the Central Receipt and Dispatch Section, Administrative Building of the university, on all working days between 12.00 PM and 4.30 P.M, or send it by speed post/courier. Address it to: The Registrar, University of Kalyani, P.O and P.S. Kalyani, District – Nadia, Pin – 741235, West Bengal. Write the post applied for on the top of the envelope containing the application form, in capital letters as the notice requires. Send the original Demand Draft for the application fee along with the form. Rs. 1000/- is payable by SC/ST/Differently abled (Physically as well as Visually) candidates and Rs. 1500/- by candidates belonging to UR and OBC categories. The Demand Draft is in favour of UNIVERSITY OF KALYANI payable at 'KALYANI'. Demand Draft in original for the application fee One (1) set of photocopies of all marksheets, certificates and other testimonials Six (6) photocopies of the application form only No Objection Certificate (NOC) / forwarding from/by the existing employer, if applicable Applications received after 27/11/2026 (up to 4.30 P.M.) are not entertained, including for postal delay.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an interview. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee a call for interview, and the University reserves the right to decide the number of candidates to be called. Candidates may have to send scanned copies of all submitted documents to the Registrar electronically before the interview, if necessary, so they should retain a complete set, including publications if any. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications are liable to be cancelled. The University reserves the right to withdraw the notification at any time, partially or completely, if situations so warrant. In that case the application fees will be refunded to the respective candidates. The NOC or forwarding is needed only if applicable, that is, for candidates with an existing employer. Candidates must keep a complete set of scanned copies of all submitted documents, including the application form and publications if any.

faq.question: Q1. How many Director posts has the University of Kalyani announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 (one) post of Director on a full-time regular basis at the Directorate of Open and Distance Learning.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the University of Kalyani Director post?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026, up to 4.30 P.M. Applications received later, including due to postal delay, will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the University of Kalyani Director post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. degree is required, with a minimum 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at Master's degree in any discipline in Humanities, Social Sciences, Sciences, Education, Commerce, Law and Management. At least 10 years' experience in teaching and research is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the University of Kalyani Director post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 68 (Sixty-Eight) years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the University of Kalyani Director?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 1,44,200 per month, and other allowances are not admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000 for SC/ST/Differently abled (Physically as well as Visually) candidates and Rs. 1500 for UR and OBC candidates, paid by Demand Draft in favour of UNIVERSITY OF KALYANI payable at Kalyani.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Director post at the University of Kalyani?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed form from https://www.klyuniv.ac.in and submit it in person at the Central Receipt and Dispatch Section, or send it by speed post/courier to The Registrar, University of Kalyani, P.O and P.S. Kalyani, District – Nadia, Pin – 741235, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the Director's tenure, and can it be extended?
faq.answer: The tenure is one year from the date of joining. It may be extended subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Does the notice prefer any experience?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with relevant experience in the Distance Education System will be preferred.
